title: Reducing Sensitivity on Speaker Names for Text Generation from Dialogues

bias_targets.methodology: Counterfactual name substitution in input dialogues to measure the variance and performance differences in text generation (using metrics like ROUGE, BLEU, and BERTScore) when only speaker names are changed.

Grouping speaker names by racial demographics (Non-Hispanic White, Hispanic or Latino, Non-Hispanic Black, Asian or Pacific Islander) based on real-world distributions, and evaluating generation sensitivity and discrimination across these demographic groups.

Categorizing speaker names by their frequency and linguistic usage in pre-training corpora (Frequent, Polysemous, Rare, Unknown) and analyzing model generation sensitivity across these different categories.
